_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Summary Report of Missing Passenger and Cargo Manifests
summary: The Summary Report of Missing Passenger and Cargo Manifests tracks and resolves un-billable Transportation Working Capital Fund cargo and passenger manifests missing for more than seven days.
use_relationship:
The Summary Report of Missing Passenger and Cargo Manifests documents the contractors' effort towards achieving contract objectives. The Report is based upon monthly, quarterly, and fiscal year financial reconciliation efforts and activities. The Report identifies Transportation Working Capital Fund (TWCF) cargo and passenger final manifests that are in a missing status for more than seven days. The Report will be used to track and resolve un-billable cargo and passenger movement on Air Mobility Command transport aircraft. The Report will detail potential write offs of expenses to the TWCF that were mitigated.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Summary Report of Missing Passenger and Cargo Manifests shall be in Microsoft Excel format. The Report shall be in a monthly, quarterly, and cumulative fiscal year format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Summary Report of Missing Passenger and Cargo Manifests shall contain the following:

children.title: Number of air inbound, air outbound, and surface manifests that took greater than seven days to be successfully transmitted to the Distribution Component Billing System (DCBS)
Number of corrected missing manifests by Combatant Command (COCOM), then by Aerial Port Code (APC) that generated the manifest transaction.
children.content: For each APC the following shall be included:

children.title: Number of attempts to submit missing manifests
Number of shipments cleared from missing manifests
Cargo weight in short tons cleared from missing manifests
Total passengers cleared from missing manifests
Total revenue and non-revenue generating manifests cleared that were not submitted or missing based on classification of mission flown
